title: 第7章 炉鼎第8章 迎人真是好姑娘啊
content_zh:
;;
敖鹏看了一眼酒液，系统的提示音继续。
【这是一杯虎血酒，最是壮阳。】
于是敖鹏毫不犹豫，端起酒杯一饮而尽。
酒液入肚之后，一股火热的力量开始在小腹中沸腾。
【你饮用了虎血酒，欲念开始在你体内升起……】
只不过系统的提示忽然在这里断掉。
那本应该从小腹腾起，灌入四肢，甚至大脑的火热快速消散，他的身体开始变得冰冷起来。
他可是一具还魂尸！
进入这里之前一个时辰左右，他就主动停止了吃香火！
所以现在身体没有香火支撑，正在开始逐渐变冷。
而一具冰冷的尸体能有多少欲念呢？
【因为你特殊的体质，虎血酒的作用大幅度降低。】
于是敖鹏翻了翻酒杯，对着要施展手段的迎人说道，“迎人姑娘，这酒真好喝，不过我现在有点冷，能多来一杯吗？”
本来准备宽衣解带的迎人一愣，她看向敖鹏。
正常情况下，别说是男人，就算是阉人喝了一杯虎血酒也应该血气上涌，满脸通红，但眼前这个男的竟然脸色开始泛着冷意的白。
【迎人对你的状态很好奇，于是她再给你倒了一杯虎血酒。】
迎人愣神之后，笑道，“当然可以。”
虎血酒是壮阳之物，也是一种珍贵的补药，只不过这些补药最终都通过某种方式回到了欢喜宗的菩萨们体内，所以迎人自然不怕敖鹏多喝。
敖鹏又满饮了一杯。

【迎人开始对你施展妙相。】
【你佩戴了‘黄仙克星’称号，你免疫基础幻术，降低妙相对你的精神影响。】
【你的精神属性2.4，你通过了这次妙相判断。】
迎然后看向敖鹏，“公子可有小腹腾腾热火之感？”
敖鹏咂吧咂吧嘴，“有点冷，还请迎人姑娘再赐一杯酒暖身。”
敖鹏将手里的酒杯递了过去。
迎人手指碰到敖鹏手掌的一瞬间，仿佛被冷气烫了一下。
好冷！
迎人忍不住看向敖鹏，脸上的笑意变淡，“公子究竟是人是鬼？”
敖鹏毫不犹豫笑道，“当然是人，只不过刚刚外面寒冷，我又是个凉薄命，需要多喝几杯酒取暖。”
他暗中吸食10点系统香火，脸色逐渐开始泛红。
【迎人对你的身份开始产生了怀疑……】
【你吸食了香火，逐渐有了人气。】
【你的‘示弱’技能产生影响，你被几百位优秀的黄大仙们敕封，以迎人的道行无法看破你的伪装。】
迎人再次摸了摸敖鹏的手，皮肤软的，有脉搏在轻微跳动，只是从内向外透着冷意，确实是人。
迎人脸色从阴转晴，笑道，“公子何苦说凉薄命，我们不过同是天涯沦落人罢了。”
说着，她又摸出了一小壶虎血酒。
content_en:
;;
Ao Peng glanced at the wine, and the system beep continued.
[This is a glass of tiger blood wine, the most aphrodisiac. 】
So Ao Peng did not hesitate, picked up the wine glass and drank it all in one gulp.
After the wine entered his stomach, a fiery power began to boil in his lower abdomen.
[You drank tiger blood wine, and desire began to rise in your body...]
It's just that the system prompts suddenly stopped here.
The heat that should have risen from his lower abdomen, poured into his limbs, and even his brain quickly dissipated, and his body began to become cold.
He is a resurrected corpse!
About an hour before entering here, he voluntarily stopped eating incense!
So now the body is not supported by incense and is starting to get colder.
And how much desire can a cold corpse have?
[Because of your special physique, the effect of tiger blood wine is greatly reduced. 】
So Ao Peng turned over the wine glass and said to Yingren who was about to use his method, "Miss Yingren, this wine is really delicious, but I'm a little cold now. Can I have another glass?"
Yingren, who was about to take off her clothes, was startled, and she looked at Ao Peng.
Under normal circumstances, let alone a man, even an eunuch should have a surge of blood and a flushed face after drinking a glass of tiger blood wine, but the face of the man in front of him turned a cold white.
[Yingren is very curious about your state, so she pours you another glass of tiger blood wine. 】
After being stunned, he smiled and said, "Of course."
Tiger blood wine is an aphrodisiac and a precious tonic, but these tonics eventually return to the bodies of the Bodhisattvas of the Huanxi Sect in some way, so Yingren is naturally not afraid of Ao Peng drinking more.
Ao Peng drank another full glass.
[Yingren starts to show his wonderful features to you. 】
[You wear the title of 'Huangxian Nemesis', you are immune to basic illusions and reduce the mental impact of Miao Xiang on you. 】
[Your mental attributes are 2.4, and you passed this wonderful judgment. 】
He then looked at Ao Peng, "Master, do you feel a burning sensation in your lower abdomen?"
Ao Peng smacked his lips and said, "It's a bit cold. Please give me another glass of wine to warm me up, please."
Ao Peng handed over the wine glass in his hand.
The moment Yingren's fingers touched Ao Peng's palm, he felt as if he had been burned by the cold air.
So cold!
Yingren couldn't help but look at Ao Peng, and the smile on his face faded, "Is the young master a human or a ghost?"
Ao Peng smiled without hesitation, "Of course he is a human being, but it was cold outside just now, and I am a cold-blooded person. I need to drink a few more glasses of wine to keep warm."
He secretly smoked 10 points of system incense, and his face gradually began to turn red.
[Yingren is beginning to have doubts about your identity...]
[You smoke incense and gradually become popular. 】
[Your 'Showing Weakness' skill has had an impact. You have been banned by hundreds of outstanding Huang Taixians. You can't see through your disguise with your welcome. 】
Yingren touched Ao Peng's hand again. The skin was soft and the pulse was beating slightly, but there was a coldness from the inside out. It was indeed a human being.
Yingren's face changed from gloomy to bright, and he smiled and said, "Young master, why do you say that you are so miserable? We are just the same people who have fallen from the world."
As she spoke, she took out a small pot of tiger blood wine.
